visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a white baseball cap with 'ISABEL MARANT' text, silver headphones, and a green mesh tank top smiles at the camera while standing outdoors against a red brick wall. He displays his hand, which features colorful nail art. The lighting is bright, natural daylight, highlighting his skin texture and facial features. (2) The scene cuts to a handheld shot where the man is sitting on a moving motorcycle taxi. He smiles broadly, holding a green shoulder bag. The background shows blurred urban elements including a street, a gate, and buildings passing by at a moderate speed. (3) The man walks on a paved sidewalk and points upward toward a brightly colored storefront sign that reads 'kantima salon'. The urban environment is filled with various signs and typical street furniture, illuminated by flat, overcast natural light. (4) The camera shows a quick montage of the salon's interior, which is densely packed with vibrant green and yellow shelving units. These shelves are filled with diverse retail items like socks, stationary, and accessories, creating a high-energy, colorful indoor atmosphere. (5) Close-up shots focus on the man's hands as a female manicurist with pink-and-white nails uses a colorful nail file to shape his nails. The table is cluttered with nail polish bottles, tools, and a pink workstation mat. The lighting is bright studio-style indoor light. (6) The process continues with a fine brush applying intricate designs, including blue flames and a smiley face. A small white handheld UV light labeled 'baifern' is used to cure a 3D black letter 'P' on his thumb. Other customers and staff are visible in the soft-focus background. (7) The man takes a mirror selfie using a gold smartphone with a white circular accessory. The mirror has pink variety-style text reading 'You are a masterpiece' written on it. The reflection reveals the colorful, busy interior of the salon and the man's finished nail art. (8) Detailed close-up shots show the finished nails on both hands held against a vibrant green grass background. Designs include a yellow smiley face, blue and white flames, the letters 'P' and 'S', a green dinosaur-like figure, a red heart, and floral patterns. (9) The man returns to an outdoor street setting next to a white metal fence. He smiles enthusiastically, gives a thumbs up, and blows a kiss to the camera. The bright natural light emphasizes the successful completion of his beauty experience.
